premise.zh: 真相一点一点拼出来，但每一块证据都可能伤到无辜的人。好玩在“查得清”和“下不下得了手”是两件事。
premise.en: The truth comes together piece by piece, and every piece can hurt someone innocent. The fun is that knowing and acting are two different things.

proof.zh: 证据：能核验的才算，同一来源的传言不能算两条。
proof.en: Proof: only what can be verified counts; two rumors from one source are one.

currency.zh: 经费、人情：查案要花钱，花了就欠了谁。
currency.en: Currency: investigating costs money, and money means owing someone.

time.zh: 时间、余裕：拖得越久，对方准备得越好。
time.en: Time: the longer it takes, the readier the other side is.

risk.zh: 暴露：被对手察觉。到线必须出事。
risk.en: Exposure: being noticed by the other side. Cross the line and something must happen.

failures.en: Exposed: the other side moves first

failures.zh: 证据链断：关键一环说不出来源
failures.en: A broken chain: a key link can't be sourced

failures.zh: 误伤：真相落在无辜的人身上
failures.en: Collateral: the truth lands on the innocent

checklist.zh: 证据程序是剧情规则，不写成现实中的法律或调查教程
checklist.en: Evidence procedure is a story rule, never a real-world legal or investigation guide

checklist.zh: 原著人物保留自己的目标，不围着玩家转
checklist.en: Characters from the book keep their own goals; they don't orbit the player
